From the definition and period 6:
\[
f(0)=0,\quad f(1)=1,\quad f(2)=2,\quad f(3)=3,\quad f(4)=f(-2)=0,\quad f(5)=f(-1)=-1.
\]
So one full 6-term period sums to
\[
1+2+3+0-1+0=5.
\]
Since
\[
2015=6\cdot 335+5,
\]
the total is
\[
335\cdot 5 + (f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4)+f(5))
=1675+5=1680.
\]
\[
\boxed{1680}
\]
